spans.s: कहय कहय, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कहाह कहाह, अस्, m. a buffalo.
कहूय कहूय, अस्, m., N. of a man.

कहोड कहोड, अस्, m., N. of a man, with
the patronymic कौषीतकि or कौषीतकेय; (अम्),
n. title of a work derived from him.

कह्लार कह्लार, अम्, n. the white esculent
water-lily, Nymphæa Lotus; sometimes spelt कल्-
हार.

कह्व कह्व, अस्, m. a kind of crane, Ardea
Nivea.

काहका काहका, f. a kind of musical instru-
ment; [cf. काहला.]

काहल काहल, अस्, आ, अम्, dry, withered;
large, excessive; mischievous; (अस्), m. a cat; a
cock; a sound in general; (आ), f. a kind of musical
instrument; N. of an Apsaras; (ई), f. a young
woman; (अम्), n. indistinct speech; a kind of musical
instrument; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a horn, either a cow-
horn or an instrument of that shape; a large drum;
(अम्), ind. much, excessively.
—काहला-पुष्प,
अस्, m. a thorn-apple, Datura Metel, = धूस्तूर.
काहलिन्, ई, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
काहलि काहलि, इस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.

काहाबाह काहाबाह, अम्, n., Ved. a rumbling
noise in the bowels.

काही काही, f. the plant Wrightia Anti-
dysenterica; [cf. कुटज.]

काहूजी काहूजी, ईस्, m., N. of the father of the
writer Mahādeva (author of an astronomical work).
